text: WELCOME TO THE CONSULTATION. I AM DR. AGENT. I NEED TO ASK YOU SOME QUESTIONS ABOUT THIS NEWBORN. HOW OLD IS THE BABY IN DAYS, AND WHEN DID THE SYMPTOMS FIRST BEGIN?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The lack of prenatal care and immunization records in a newborn female presents a high-risk profile for congenital syphilis, which should be the primary differential diagnosis given the maternal history. I am requesting the results of a VDRL test and a Full Blood Count to confirm this suspicion.
